_about: The photo backdrop library for free scene templates. Each entry is one empty backdrop image, generated ONCE (by hand, in any image tool) from its prompt and saved here as <id>.jpg (or .png/.webp). scenes.py reads this file; an entry whose image is not here yet is simply skipped. anchor is where the product attaches, as fractions of the image (x, y); box is the largest the product may be drawn (w, h, fractions); mode says which point of the product sits on the anchor: base (it stands there), center (flat-lay), top (it hangs from there). light is where the light comes FROM. Regenerate the prompt sheet with: python scripts/scene_prompts.py
suffix: Photorealistic high-end commercial product photography backdrop, sharp focus, natural soft shadows, vertical 9:16 frame. The empty spot described above must stay completely empty: no product, no bottle, no jewellery, nothing placed there. No text, no logo, no watermark.
